cme_matching.title: Supported Matching Algorithms - CME Group Client Systems Wiki
facts: FIFO uses price and time as the only criteria; orders at the same price are filled by time priority; the first order at a price level is the first matched
An order loses priority and is re-queued if its quantity is increased, its price changed, or its account number changed
Other Globex algorithms include Allocation, FIFO with LMM, Pro-Rata, Configurable, Threshold Pro-Rata

cme_matching_overview.title: Matching Algorithm Overview - CME Group
facts: Resting orders are matched with aggressing orders using the CME Group algorithms

cme_order_qualifiers.title: Order Qualifiers - CME Group Client Systems Wiki
facts: Display quantity specifies the quantity of an order shown to the market, replenishes that quantity when filled, and exposes the entire order gradually until depleted (this is the exchange-native iceberg)

cme_order_types.title: Futures Order Types - CME Group
facts: Common order types are market, limit and stop
A market limit order executes at the best available price; if only partly filled, the rest becomes a limit order resting at that price
A limit order cannot be filled worse than its limit price but can be filled better

investor_gov_orders.title: Investor Bulletin: Understanding Order Types - Investor.gov (SEC)
facts: A market order is to buy or sell at the best available price, generally executed immediately, but the price is not guaranteed
A buy limit executes only at the limit or lower; a sell limit only at the limit or higher

cme_micro_faq.title: Micro E-mini Equity Index Futures: FAQ - CME Group
facts: E-mini S&P 500 multiplier is $50 and Micro is $5
E-mini Nasdaq-100 multiplier is $20 and Micro is $2
Micro tick increments follow the E-mini: 0.25 index points (MES $1.25, MNQ $0.50), so ES tick = 0.25 x $50 = $12.50 and NQ tick = 0.25 x $20 = $5.00

cme_gold.title: Gold Futures Contract Specs - CME Group
facts: Contract unit is 100 troy ounces
Minimum tick is 0.10 per troy ounce = $10.00
CME Globex hours are Sunday-Friday 6:00pm-5:00pm ET with a 60-minute daily break

cme_crude.title: Crude Oil Futures Contract Specs - CME Group
facts: Contract unit is 1,000 barrels
Minimum price fluctuation is 0.01 per barrel = $10.00 (as listed in the CME spec table)

bis_fx_2022.title: OTC foreign exchange turnover in April 2022 - BIS Triennial Survey
facts: OTC FX trading reached $7.5 trillion per day in April 2022 (net-net, all FX instruments)
FX is an over-the-counter market (no single central exchange), so there is no single consolidated volume figure for spot FX

tv_vp_basics.title: Volume profile indicators: basic concepts - TradingView
facts: Volume profile displays trading activity over a period at price levels as a histogram
TradingView builds profiles from lower-timeframe bars (e.g. 1-minute bars for a daily session)
It uses up/down volume, not buy/sell: if a bar's close >= open the bar's volume counts as up, otherwise down
Volume used: trade volume for stocks; TICK volume (number of price updates) for indices, forex and crypto CFDs
POC is the price with the highest traded volume; value area is the range holding a specified percentage of volume, typically 70%
Profile types: auto anchored, fixed range, periodic, session, session HD, visible range

tv_frvp.title: Fixed Range Volume Profile indicator - TradingView
facts: FRVP calculates volume data within a user-specified time range

tv_svp.title: Session Volume Profile - TradingView
facts: SVP calculates volume data within a specified session or sub-session

tv_avwap.title: Anchored VWAP drawing tool - TradingView
facts: Anchored VWAP displays the volume-weighted average price starting from a user-selected point

sierra_vwap.title: VWAP with Standard Deviation Lines - Sierra Chart
facts: The standard deviation bands are computed from volume-weighted squared deviations of price from VWAP, divided by total volume, then square-rooted
Sierra Chart also offers a Draw Anchored VWAP tool

sierra_vbp.title: Volume By Price study - Sierra Chart
facts: Volume by Price has settings for value area percentage, POC highlighting, peaks and valleys (HVN/LVN) and bid/ask volume colouring

sierra_numbers.title: Numbers Bars - Sierra Chart
facts: Numbers Bars (Sierra's footprint) show bid and ask volume per price; they need only best bid/ask with each trade, not market depth
Cumulative delta is the running sum of ask volume minus bid volume

nt_volumetric.title: Order Flow Volumetric Bars - NinjaTrader 8 Help Guide
facts: Imbalance compares buying volume with selling volume diagonally below: e.g. buy 1000 vs sell 300 diagonal below = buying imbalance at the default ratio 1.5
Clusters of imbalances can form support/resistance areas (their words)
Bar statistics include delta, delta %, cumulative delta, min/max delta

atas_imbalances.title: Volume Imbalances in Footprint: Why Diagonal Comparison Matters - ATAS
facts: An ask imbalance is when aggressive buys at a level are several times greater than aggressive sells one level below; comparison is diagonal because it reflects order-book mechanics
ATAS uses 200% as an imbalance and 400% as strong, adjustable per instrument

bookmap_icebergs.title: Stops & Icebergs On-Chart Indicator - Bookmap Knowledge Base
facts: Iceberg orders are limit orders split into smaller visible pieces to hide the total quantity
The add-on detects icebergs only from CME MBO (market-by-order) data
CME does not allow native icebergs on certain instruments

investopedia_vwap.title: VWAP: Definition and Calculation - Investopedia
facts: VWAP = cumulative (price x volume) / cumulative volume
Charting packages often approximate with typical price (H+L+C)/3 per bar
VWAP resets each session

wiki_market_profile.title: Market profile - Wikipedia (history, secondary)
facts: Devised by J. Peter Steidlmayer, a CBOT trader; introduced publicly in 1985 as the CBOT Market Profile product
TPO = time price opportunity; letters mark 30-minute periods
Initial balance = range of the first hour; day types include neutral, non-trend and trend day
Value area described as the central 70% of activity about the POC, by a normal-distribution analogy
Steidlmayer and Kevin Koy started Market Logic School in 1986

dalton_mom.title: Mind Over Markets, Updated Edition (Dalton, Jones, Dalton; Wiley 2013) - O'Reilly listing
facts: Authors James F. Dalton, Eric T. Jones, Robert B. Dalton; Wiley, July 2013; credits Steidlmayer as pioneer of the theories. FURTHER READING ONLY, the text was not opened

steidlmayer_koy.title: Markets and Market Logic (Steidlmayer & Koy, Porcupine Press 1986) - Google Books listing
facts: Bibliographic only: Porcupine Press 1986, 161 pages. FURTHER READING ONLY

tv_tpo.title: Time price opportunity charts explained - TradingView
facts: Each letter is one block of time in the profile period (5, 10, 15, 30 min, 1h, 2h, 4h); letters run A-Z then a-z
A letter block appears at each price where activity occurred in that time segment
A value area setting sets the percentage of blocks used

sierra_tpo.title: TPO (Time Price Opportunity) Profile Charts - Sierra Chart
facts: Settings include Initial Balance Range and IBR extensions, TPO value area %, TPO POC, 'Count 2 Levels at a Time for Value Area', Extend Singles, Extend Poor High/Poor Low, opening range highlight

cftc_spoofing.title: Fact Sheet: Interpretive Guidance on Disruptive Practices (CEA 4c(a)(5)) - CFTC
facts: CEA section 4c(a)(5)(C) makes it unlawful to engage in trading that is, is of the character of, or is commonly known as 'spoofing' (bidding or offering with the intent to cancel the bid or offer before execution)

cme_mbo.title: Market by Order (MBO) FAQ - CME Group
facts: MBO is an order-based data feed showing individual queue position, full depth and individual order sizes at each price
Market by Price (MBP) aggregates quantity per level (previously max 10 levels)
Each order has an anonymous OrderID and PriorityID; no customer-identifying information
CME MBO rollout ran Dec 2016 to June 2017

tv_footprint.title: Volume footprint charts: a complete guide - TradingView
facts: Seller volume shown left and buyer volume right of each candle
Buy/sell is categorised from the direction of intrabar price moves (intrabar close > open = buy, < open = sell; ties use the prior intrabar close), not from trade-by-trade aggressor data
Intrabar source for intraday charts: 1 tick on professional plans, otherwise 1 second or 1 minute
Guide covers imbalance detection, failed auction, delta divergence

cme_6e.title: Euro FX (6E) futures overview - CME Group
facts: CME lists Euro FX futures (Globex code 6E) on EUR/USD, with exchange-reported volume
